title: Halting from an Answer State
statement: Let $m$ and $b$ be Boolean values, let $h$ be a bit string, and let $v$ assign a natural number to each of nine registers, with every register value at most $4|h|+4$. Starting from the answer state for $b$, with register values $v$ and no answer yet recorded, the computation halts with answer $b$, and every configuration before halting satisfies the stated computation invariant.
